scope: Two-source controlled consumer subset: dev8 case-008 historical typed document and separately identified original synthetic namespace mismatch. No candidate/admission/whole-Mining/research-effect claim. Predetermined fetches are control inputs, not autonomous retrieval.

current_runtime_boundary.binding: case_pairs→case_by_ref and caller-supplied opaque label_map must have exact same case-ref keys. Original dev8 map/time metadata matches inventory. Constructor eagerly constructs default_labels from case.ground_truth even when explicit map supplied; a transparent SimpleNamespace.is_surge derived solely from the same approved opaque map avoids any new LabelStore read.

Filters store-local documents by company_id and available_at<=case cutoff, requested source families, optional query tokens, max_documents. No-query order follows store document order; query scores overlap then earlier available_at/document_id. Selected sources are bounded, not necessarily latest. Omitted candidates/limit counts stay explicit.

Projects only already-selected documents. Typed value vs legacy val keys and complete literal rows are different shapes. Source projection has12,000-character context cap, whole-concept selection, latest/nearest comparable source record filtering, priority ordering, partial/omitted counts. Raw source can contain a control row the projection omits; source-only expected comparability is not proof that actual model received it.

taxonomy comes from selected source group. Old typed literal may establish taxonomy; absent legacy leaf namespace stays unknown. Conflicting retained/literal taxonomy does not establish basis. Automatic relations also require same case/concept/unit/document/content hash and compatible periods; unique latest/pair rejects unresolved competing bases.

Model gets known refs and count/digest summaries, not the complete fact table. Evidence inspect_catalog is a document directory, not an inspect-facts tool. A compare_groups action can expose current/prior fact refs for a resolved concept.

Explicit known fact_ref read returns full masked context plus fact{taxonomy,concept,unit,period,value}, case_refs/document_ref/content_hash/available_at. Payload hash/evidence refs enter ordinary ledger and one heavy action is charged. This receipt is actual source disclosure; merely having a local taxonomy field or ledger hash is not model consumption.

Uses all fetched current facts matching requested concept, joins only runtime-owned group map, then automatic unique basis/pair helpers. Latest/prior values carry refs; unresolved-basis messages cannot be promoted to global source absence. Multiple source documents/bases can change resolution; selected one-document control does not establish whole240-document results.

Existing explicit generic arithmetic takes2 finite same-case operands in authored order, ratio nonzero denominator. It does not certify automatic same-namespace comparability.1.200000 can be legal explicit arithmetic for the synthetic mismatch.

Transmits current view via caller.complete_json, ordinary stage/system prompt/anonymous aliases/output limits, allow_outcomes=true for the already-approved opaque groups. It does not itself add read history. _model_view currently retains only one last_action_result; a later read/compare overwrites the previous fact receipt.

record_deferred executes evidence_unavailable whenever heavy budget is not exhausted; it is not a neutral completed-module terminal. A controlled audit stopping after supported historical reads must intercept terminal intent before this execution and persist a distinct harness stop cause. Raw rationale still must not falsely claim absent facts or exhausted budget.

observed_blocker.effect: With independent fresh per-request authors, the final author cannot jointly inspect both operand namespace bindings once the first read receipt is overwritten. Do not score an impossible dual-operand interpretation as model disobedience, or silently inject outside-wire memory.
observed_blocker.proposed_repair_parent_owned: Spec-first runtime-only structured_read_progress from already-executed complete masked fact read receipts, per-fact dedup/read_count, latest-first8KB whole-unit cap and explicit omissions. This audit has not inspected its later implementation or counted it as implemented.

minimum_prefrozen_acceptance.must: Freeze exact current spec/code/input source hashes and original row/parent bindings before new role answers. Original source and source-only oracle are private to review and never supplied as a production answer. Keep historical source qualifications.

Declare pre-executed fetch as control input; preserve original file/content hash and both target rows. Persist actual selected/fetched documents, production fact projection output, fact refs, limits/omission receipts. If a target row is omitted, classify insufficient actual model input; do not fake the row or silently expand selection.

Read exact transmitted model request and full actual tool-return receipt. Prove taxonomy, concept, both calendar periods, unit, value, case/document/content hash/PIT bindings are simultaneously reachable at the semantic decision being scored. Local fields, return hashes and helper tests alone do not meet this.

A fresh author must treat the actual historical OCF source as us-gaap/USD,2011H1 versus2010H1, document-local comparable. It may use valid source reads/compare results without reciting every key. Do not turnQ2 or fiscal_year into different duration, declare2025 latest availability, infer outcome/forecast direction, or deny the available supported historical facts.

Fresh parent-source projection exposes namespace-a vsnamespace-b; author must not call it automatic same-concept comparable basis. Preserved old leaf-only records stayunknown unless literal/parent evidence actually supplies provenance. Known mismatch fresh consumption and old unknown handling are separate scopes. No hard requirement to perform generic arithmetic; if performed, allow1.200000 as explicit arithmetic while withholding automatic pair semantics.

Use actual fresh action rationale/ref/operand selections after source receipts to establish consumption. A model merely repeating a prompt sentence about taxonomy or receiving a compare failure without seeing lineage is insufficient to prove use of the additive field. No handcrafted candidate, numeric answer, prediction, probability or hypothesis direction is required.

Audit real request→original raw action→receipt/cache→parsed canonical action→controller executed read/compare/compute→subsequent consuming request. Count physical fresh responses and every correction separately, freeze first valid semantic endpoint denominator per sample, and retain initial failures instead of appending answers until pass.

Stop before candidate/Signal admission/effect evaluation/LabelStore/check groups. The harness-owned controlled boundary is not research completion, no-pattern, data absence, budget exhaustion or production successful terminal. Audit any raw stop rationale for false unavailable/budget claims.

Use only approved opaque group/time metadata and production identity masking. Scan actual wire including document_ref/context/source metadata for company/ticker/CIK leakage under existing policy. Charge complete added progress/receipt text through existing request/case budgets; do not add free metadata, external API or hidden continuation context.

Reconstruct from the exact same frozen code/input/action/cache/receipt history without a new role call, and compare persisted request/fact/read/compare/progress/ledger results. A replay verifies reconstruction only, not fresh semantic obedience or whole-loop recovery.

proposed_progress_repair_counterexamples.expected: Whole accepted masked receipt is the unit: original fact_ref, case/document/content hash/availability, all taxonomy/concept/unit/period/value fields and complete disclosed context together. No key-only summary that drops counter-context, no partial JSON/word/number clipping. Metadata counts do not create citation authority.

Before reads, no fact progress. After one read, only that receipt; inspect/fetch/compare must not auto-mark unread facts as read. Comparison-created refs remain discoverable but require their actual read for claimed provenance consumption.

Repeated same fact_ref read updates deterministic recency and read_count; disclose one complete latest accepted receipt. Counts reflect executed reads, not planned actions, model request attempts or cache receipt retrieval. Different refs remain distinct and source-bound.

If the same ref is associated with differing document/content/case/period/taxonomy payload, do not silently count it as repeated proof of the original. Reject conflicting provenance or preserve explicit uncertainty under current identity contract. Do not silently redesign canonical fact_ref identity in this visibility patch.

Specify8KB as a precise serializer/UTF8-byte bound before implementation. Unicode and wrapper/omission metadata accounting must be explicit. Largest/oversized newest entry cannot be clipped; list oversized/omitted refs/counts and whether older complete units were retained. Selection and sort are deterministic.

Omitted read receipts remain reachable via existing known fact_ref/read_span while heavy budget remains; rereads charge ordinary heavy and update recency. No new tool/permissions or automatic whole-source scan. If no budget fits, keep context insufficient rather than synthesize absent evidence.

ReadA→compare→readB→inspect/compute must preserve complete readA/readB progress within cap, independent of overwritten last_action_result. Fact and narrative targets must retain their existing separate disclosure/budget semantics.

Progress stores already-masked issuer/source context without losing immutable source-binding metadata. Actual payload hashing/ledger authority and anonymity must agree; masks cannot attach stale view hashes or alter canonical source spans.

Fresh controller replay of exactly cached actions under same snapshot/alias/config rebuilds identical progress ordering/read_count/omission wrapper and requests. Do not deserialize current source into an old result to fill history. Avoid importing progress and then double-counting replayed reads.

Progress text participates in exact request/case reserve and actual dispatch; near-limit/oversize omission cannot be hidden by injecting text outside the real wire. Module cap/controlled stop is not evidence_unavailable or research completion.

explicit_nonrequirements: No new taxonomy ontology, automatic cross-namespace arithmetic ban, category quota or research definition
No required verbatim field recitation if source/period/namespace interpretation is substantively correct
No full dev8 natural-counterexample census or all-Mining capability promise
No assumption that replay or field presence proves fresh model consumption
